stemMarkdown: A bag contains 5 red balls and 5 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are red? (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Choose 2 from the 5 red balls out of 2 from all 10: $\dfrac{\binom{5}{2}}{\binom{10}{2}} = \dfrac{10}{45} = 0.222222$.
